verdict.rationale: Render is a general cloud app platform rather than an edge-function runtime. Its Docker support and ability to run standard software such as self-hosted ClickHouse suggest code is not tied to a proprietary runtime and can be moved elsewhere. However, nothing in the evidence addresses standard edge runtime APIs or portability across edge platforms. Missing for 10: any evidence of edge deployment, of standards-based runtime APIs (e.g. Web-standard fetch/Request), of explicit no-lock-in or portability claims for storage APIs, and of independent corroboration of unmodified cross-platform portability.
